title: I'm vibecoding a WoW style RTS raid management game, but I want it to be better
author: Bright-Initiative-32
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/hrdytvvwploh1.png?width=1915&format=png&auto=webp&s=c86a82f5640ee740956dafa75407313b2ab9b965

Screenshot is 5 versions ago, it's a lot better off now. Primarily using Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 to get in things like the basic UI, stat formulas, damage, boss scripts, basic models etc, but I want it to not only look better, but flow better in general. 

  
In terms of looks - outside of spending 1000s to commission 3D models with animations, what options do I have? I have a few concepts, both hand drawn and ChatGPT generated images that pretty much look like how I want it to

  
In terms of sound - again, outside of spending 1000s to commission music, spell sounds, sword hits, etc, what options do I have?

I'm not sure if this is going to be a public thing I release until I reach a few milestones.

comments.author: AI_EXPERIMENT
comments.body:
You can integrate blender into your workflow to help create models. 

Honest question, why make this game when there are already so many?

replies.author: Bright-Initiative-32
replies.body:
Can you explain what you mean by integrate Blender? Claude created a few models (you can see it in the image), but I want slightly more realism while maintaining a cartoonish charm. Right now it just looks like a bunch of boxes thrown together. I am impressed with what it created, for sure,

I am not aware of any games specifically like this (I looked, I found only two *kind of* similar, but not the same idea). Could you point me to what you're referring to?
